-- S2 classic-egg-only DEV feature. The sole original Game and Remote remain
-- authoritative; five-egg score mode is fail-closed until H2Score supports it.
local function applyClassicEggRelay(player: Player, data)
    if not classicRelayEnabled() or EXPERIMENTAL_FIVE_EGG_MODE
        or match.phase ~= "ACTIVE" or type(data) ~= "table"
        or type(data.targetUserId) ~= "number" or data.targetUserId % 1 ~= 0
        or math.abs(data.targetUserId)>9007199254740991
        or type(data.eggId) ~= "string" then return end
    if not Rules.validSeq(data.seq, lastSeq[player] or 0) then return end
    lastSeq[player] = data.seq
    local target: Player? = nil
    for _,candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if candidate.UserId == data.targetUserId then target = candidate;break end
    end
    if not target or target == player or target.Parent ~= Players then return end
    local egg = carry[player]
    if egg == nil or egg ~= data.eggId or carry[target] ~= nil
        or match.eggOwners[egg] ~= player then return end
    local aliveA, rootA = healthy(player)
    local aliveB, rootB = healthy(target)
    if not aliveA or not aliveB or rootA == nil or rootB == nil then return end
    local direction = rootB.Position - rootA.Position
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character, target.Character}
    local blocked = workspace:Raycast(rootA.Position, direction, rayParams) ~= nil
    local version = relayVersions[egg] or 0
    -- Process-relative monotonic clock; Unix server time exceeds policy's numeric bound.
    local now = os.clock()
    local positions = {
        [player.UserId] = {alive=true,team=getTeamName(player),
            stunned=slowed[player]~=nil,restrained=slowed[player]~=nil,
            carriedEggId=egg,
            serverPosition={x=rootA.Position.X,y=rootA.Position.Y,z=rootA.Position.Z}},
        [target.UserId] = {alive=true,team=getTeamName(target),
            stunned=slowed[target]~=nil,restrained=slowed[target]~=nil,
            carriedEggId=carry[target],
            serverPosition={x=rootB.Position.X,y=rootB.Position.Y,z=rootB.Position.Z}},
    }
    local world = {phase="PLAYING",roundEpoch=match.serial,
        nowSec=now,players=positions,
        eggs={[egg]={id=egg,phase="CARRIED",carrierUserId=player.UserId,
            relayEligible=true,transferSeq=version,lastRelayAtSec=relayLastAt[egg]}},
        lastAcceptedSeqByUser={[player.UserId]=relayAcceptedSeq[player] or 0},
        serverLineOfSightClear=not blocked}
    local allowed,receipt=EggRelay.evaluate(world,{
        actorUserId=player.UserId,targetUserId=target.UserId,eggId=egg,
        roundEpoch=data.roundEpoch,seq=data.seq,
        expectedTransferSeq=data.expectedTransferSeq})
    if not allowed or type(receipt)~="table" then return end
    -- Atomic, no-yield change of exactly ONE egg and TWO players.
    if match.phase~="ACTIVE" or EXPERIMENTAL_FIVE_EGG_MODE
        or match.serial~=receipt.roundEpoch
        or match.eggOwners[egg]~=player or carry[player]~=egg
        or carry[target]~=nil then return end
    match.eggOwners[egg]=target
    carry[player]=nil
    carry[target]=egg
    relayVersions[egg]=receipt.newTransferSeq
    relayLastAt[egg]=now
    relayAcceptedSeq[player]=data.seq
    removeCarrierVisual(player)
    giveEggVisual(target)
    broadcast() -- snapshots only; no award, HP, score or Store writes
end

local seq = 0
local relayLatest: any=nil

-- Single existing HUD sequence counter; no second Remote or client score logic.
local function nearestRelayTeammate(): Player?
    local s=relayLatest
    if type(s)~="table" or type(s.team)~="string" then return nil end
    local char=player.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end
    local best: Player?=nil
    local bestDist=math.huge
    for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local oc=other.Character
        local otherRoot=oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum=oc and oc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if other~=player and other.Team~=nil and other.Team.Name==s.team
            and otherRoot and hum and hum.Health>0 then
            local delta=otherRoot.Position-root.Position
            local horizontal=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z).Magnitude
            if math.abs(delta.Y)<=4 and horizontal<=8 and horizontal<bestDist then
                best=other
                bestDist=horizontal
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end
local function fireClassicEggRelay()
    local s=relayLatest
    if type(s)~="table" or s.phase~="ACTIVE" or s.relayEnabled~=true
        or s.scoreMode~="ONE_EGG_CAPTURE"
        or type(s.carrying)~="string" or s.carrying=="" then return end
    local target=nearestRelayTeammate()
    if not target or type(s.relayVersion)~="number"
        or s.relayVersion%1~=0 then return end
    seq+=1
    remote:FireServer({action="EGG_RELAY",seq=seq,
        targetUserId=target.UserId,eggId=s.carrying,
        roundEpoch=s.serial,expectedTransferSeq=s.relayVersion})
end
